description: Conformance fixtures for the .work format. A conformant validator MUST accept every document under valid/ with no WORK- violations, and MUST reject every document under invalid/ reporting exactly the rule identifiers listed against it.

valid.description: The smallest document that satisfies every rule. One controlled writer, one publisher, one agreement, a PWR link, shares totalling 10000 per right, no content and no signatures.

The full worked example. Two writers with only one controlled, a German sub-publisher expressed as include/exclude TIS claims, a cleared interpolation whose consideration does not affect ownership, a split registration outcome, a consent-limited render, and a double attestation on the derivation.

invalid.description: Publisher ownership is 4000 rather than 5000, so ownership totals 9000 per right. totals_bps still claims 10000 and valid:true, so this also tests that a validator recomputes rather than trusting the declared total.
publisher_for_writer is empty while a controlled SWR credit exists. There is no chain of title, and the CWR projection would be rejected by the society.
A single credit carries both writer_designation and publisher_type, which describes a composer-publisher. The two CWR vocabularies are distinct and must not be merged.
